name: Cultist: Blessing of N'Zoth converts 100% Intellect into attack power (#1295)
contract: 681107 has a single effect: Apply Aura SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_OF_STAT_PERCENT (268), EffectMiscValue 3 = Stats::STAT_INTELLECT (this aura reads the stat straight from MiscValue, not MiscValueB), EffectBasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100%. Unit::UpdateAttackPowerAndDamage (StatSystem.cpp:627-629) does `attPowerMod += CalculatePct(GetStat(Stats(MiscValue)), Amount)`, i.e. it adds 100% of current Intellect straight to melee attack power; the attack_power metric reads GetTotalAttackPowerValue(BASE_ATTACK) directly, which includes this term. StatSystem.cpp:160-181 (UpdateStatBuffMod) only calls UpdateAttackPowerAndDamage for an Intellect change when a MOD_ATTACK_POWER_OF_STAT_PERCENT aura keyed on Intellect is present, so injecting Intellect without the talent cannot move attack power at all - the negative control. The scenario isolates Intellect from the class's native Strength-based attack power term (which would otherwise confound a broader stat injection) with Arcane Intellect (1461), a stock buff whose only relevant effect is Apply Aura MOD_STAT (29), MiscValue 3 (Intellect), EffectBasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = +15; its second effect is SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_SPELL_POWER_FLAT (345), which does not touch Strength or attack power. +15 Intellect at 100% conversion must raise attack power by exactly 15 once Blessing of N'Zoth is known. Numbers read from Spell.dbc via coa-dbc-viewer. No script or SQL references 681107. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
